title: A Sign Made of Two Signs
label: ch:bn-sign-made-of-two-signs
canDo: I can read আমি and কেমন, write ল, the e-sign and its independent twin এ, and build the o-sign out of two signs I already hold rather than memorising a new shape.

payoff.summary: How read back with nothing new, and the count that shows why four pieces bought two more words — three of the four being vowel pieces, which multiply across every consonant already held.
